title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra and declares the 'AGI era'
summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, which independently discovered two unknown zero-day vulnerabilities during testing. Due to this, OpenAI assigned the model a critical cyber capabilities level and restricted powerful tools to verified defenders. Greg Brockman called the release the start of the 'AGI era'. Initially available to Daybreak program participants, then rolling out to ChatGPT, API, AWS Bedrock, and Microsoft Azure.
